bags: Each way: 1st bag $50, 2nd bag $60 (USD). Up to 50 lb / 23 kg and 62 in / 157 cm per bag
Fare is non-refundable. Cancel before scheduled departure or the ticket has no value
Check in and drop bags at least 60 minutes before departure; board 30 minutes before. Bring passports and this eTicket receipt
gettingAround: Fly into Santo Domingo (SDQ, Las Américas). Transfer to Cabrera is roughly 3–4 hours by road (estimate; check before booking)
Fly home from SDQ at 2:53 pm; leave Cabrera with enough time for the transfer back (estimate)

days.label: Sat
days.note: Arrive Santo Domingo, transfer to Cabrera

days.label: Fri
days.note: Cabrera; pack for the flight home

todos.text: Book a transfer or rental car from Santo Domingo airport to Cabrera (about 3–4 h; estimate)
Check in at least 60 minutes before each flight (EWR Feb 13, SDQ Feb 20)

places.name: Playa Grande
places.location: Río San Juan area, about 10–20 min from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Quiet, undeveloped beach with bigger waves, good for windsurfing. Free.
places.note: Cabrera Chalet is nearby.

places.name: Playa Caleton
places.location: Near Río San Juan, about 20–30 min from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Small crescent beach with a local feel and few facilities. Free.
places.note: Few amenities.

places.name: Playa Cabarete (Kite Beach)
places.location: Cabarete, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Kiteboarding and windsurfing beach with beginner schools. Free.
places.note: Sunbathing and beginner lessons.

places.name: Playa Sosúa
places.location: Sosúa, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Golden sand with a coral reef for snorkeling. Free.
places.note: Good for snorkeling.

places.name: Playa Encuentro
places.location: Cabarete area, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Surf beach with surf schools, not for calm swimming. Free.
places.note: Right-hand reef break.

places.name: Blue Lagoon
places.location: Cabrera area, a few minutes from Laguna Dudú
places.details: Two lakes connected by underground tunnels, with a zip line from the highest point. Price not found.
places.note: Hours not found. Check on arrival.

places.name: Balneario El Saltadero
places.location: Cabrera, about 5–10 min from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Natural waterfall with a large swimming pool, surrounded by rocky cliffs and vegetation. Stairs lead down to the lake, and locals jump in. Trails nearby lead to small ponds and caves. Price not found.
places.note: Hours not found. No entrance fee listed in sources.

places.name: Cuevas de Cabarete
places.location: 1 km west of Cabarete, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Guided tour of six caves, about 120 min, with an optional dip in an underwater lagoon. Tours in English, Spanish and German. RD$1,530–2,140 per tour (≈ US$25–35).
places.note: Hours not listed. The site's "195 Pts" adult price is unclear.

places.name: Parque Nacional El Choco
places.location: About 15 min from Cabarete, about 1 h 15 min from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Hiking, biking, swimming, boating and birdwatching, with bilingual guides. Pairs well with the caves. RD$1,530–2,140 per tour (≈ US$25–35).
places.note: Hours not found.

places.name: Laguna Gri-Gri
places.location: Río San Juan, about 30 min from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Boat tour through a mangrove lagoon and bird sanctuary. The tour stops at Cueva de Las Golondrinas for a swim in a shallow turquoise cove and ends at Playa Caleton. Daily guided tours. Price not found.
places.note: Best at sunset for egrets and vultures over the mangroves. Prices and hours not found.

places.name: Monkey Jungle & Zip Line Adventures
places.location: Cabarete, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Zip lining, squirrel monkey encounters and a seven-station gun range. Guide required. A full-day package with transport and a bus tour is also offered. RD$1,224–3,365 per person (≈ US$20–55).
places.note: Listed daily 9 am–4 pm. Full-day package 4–8 h from about £68 per person (≈ US$90, est.). Not confirmed on the venue's site.

places.name: 2-Person Dune Buggy Tour
places.location: Cabarete, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Countryside tour, 4.5 h, with gear and instructors included. ~RD$8,304 per 2-person buggy (≈ US$135.71).
places.note: Start times not listed.

places.name: Four-Wheeler Tour
places.location: Cabarete, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: About 4 h, an alternative to the buggy. ~RD$7,016 (≈ US$114.67).
places.note: Start times not listed.

places.name: Yasica River Kayak Tour
places.location: Cabarete and Sosúa area, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: About 5 h on the river with lunch and a snack. Hotel pickup and drop-off included. Minimum age 5. Book ahead. From ~RD$2,695 (≈ US$44.05).
places.note: Bookings open up to 2 days ahead when seats are free. Adult and child prices not listed.

places.name: Private Kayak or Paddleboard Tour, La Boca
places.location: La Boca, Cabarete, about 1 hr from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Private 2-hour tour, maximum 8 people. Kayak or paddleboard. ~RD$3,977 per person (≈ US$65).
places.note: Times not listed.

places.name: Ke Lo Ke Kafe
places.location: Catalina 3300, Cabrera, about 5–10 min from the hotel (est.)
places.details: Coffee shop with a 4.9 rating from 80 reviews. RD$500–1,000 per person (≈ US$8–16).
places.note: Known for pastries, Turkish eggs and avocado toast. Reviewers praise the service. Closed today, opens 8 am Wednesday; other hours not confirmed. LGBTQ+ friendly. No phone or website listed.

places.name: El Babunuco
places.location: Calle J No
places.details: 4 Camino Del Saltadero, Cabrera, about 5–10 min from the hotel (est.). Daily local menu: a main protein and sides. RD$730–920 per plate (≈ US$12–15, one reviewer's estimate).
places.note: Known for crab, fried fish and fresh juices. Listed hours Sun, Mon, Wed–Sat 12–10 pm, closed Tue (unconfirmed). Phone +1 829-338-8707.

places.name: Casa Grande, Playa Grande
places.location: Playa Grande, Río San Juan, about 30 min (est.)
places.details: Island-style seafood: grilled shrimp, salmon tiradito, extensive wine list. Reservations recommended, smart casual. Price not listed.
places.note: Phone (809) 589-2888. Hours not listed. The listing links to aman.com, so confirm it is the same business.

places.name: Taco Star
places.location: Playa Grande, about 30 min (est.)
places.details: Open-air beachfront spot with fresh fish tacos. Price not listed.
places.note: Beach access, hours and phone not confirmed.

places.name: Upstairs
places.location: Inside the Rip Jack Inn, Playa Grande, about 30 min (est.)
places.details: Seafood and steakhouse-style meats. Price not listed.
places.note: Beach access and hours not confirmed.

places.name: El Huerto
places.location: Playa Grande, about 30 min (est.)
places.details: Dependable continental menu. Price not listed.
places.note: Phone listed as 2653-1259 with no area code, so verify. Beach access and hours not confirmed.

places.name: The Beer Garden at ONDA
places.location: At ONDA, Playa Grande, about 30 min (est.)
places.details: International comfort food with craft beer and cocktails. Price not listed.
places.note: Listed phone 4002-2779 looks mistyped, so verify. Hours not listed.

places.name: NLB Nelson's Lounge & Bistro
places.location: Calle Antonio Javier, Sosúa, about 1 hr (est.)
places.details: Seafood, meats and pastas, with a kids' play area. $$ tier, price not listed.
places.note: Phone +1 809-571-3253. Hours not listed.

places.name: Waterfront Playa Alicia
places.location: Playa Alicia, Dr
places.details: Rosen 1, Sosúa, about 1 hr (est.). Beachfront Caribbean food, known for sunsets, cocktails and paella. $ tier, price not listed.
places.note: Phone +1 809-571-3024. Hours not listed.

places.name: Natura Restaurant
places.location: Paseo del Sol 5, Cabarete, about 1 hr (est.)
places.details: Oceanfront seafood, vegetarian and vegan options, house-made pasta. $$$ tier, price not listed.
places.note: Phone +1 849-214-7010. Hours not listed.

places.name: Restaurant Tuvá
places.location: SeaWinds Condominiums, Cabarete, about 1 hr (est.)
places.details: Mediterranean-style pasta, seafood and grilled meats. $$ tier, price not listed.
places.note: Phone +1 849-925-8818. Hours not listed.

places.name: Bliss
places.location: Callejón de la Loma 1, Cabarete, about 1 hr (est.)
places.details: Italian. Mahi and salmon carpaccio, lobster linguine. $$$ tier, price not listed.
places.note: Closed Sundays, no lunch service. Phone +1 829-701-7215.

places.name: Woke Foods
places.location: Cabarete residential zone, about 1 hr (est.)
places.details: Plant-based Dominican dishes, fresh juice and coconut water. $ tier, prices in pesos.
places.note: Vegetarian option. Phone and hours not listed.
